articles.headline: Giddey's triple-double guides Bulls home
articles.description: A breakthrough triple double for Josh Giddey snaps the Chicago Bulls' eight-game losing streak in an overtime win over Dyson Daniels' Atlanta Hawks.

articles.headline: Alperin Sengun scores 43 points to power Rockets past skidding Jazz 125-118
articles.description: — Alperin Sengun scored 43 points and pulled down 12 rebounds as the Houston Rockets held off Utah 125-118 in NBA Cup play Friday night, handing the Jazz their 11th consecutive loss.

articles.headline: Powell scores 33 as the Bulls snap 8-game skid, beating the Hawks 125-117 in OT
articles.description: — Norman Powell scored nine of his 33 points in overtime and the Chicago Bulls snapped an eight-game skid with a 125-117 victory over the Atlanta Hawks in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

articles.headline: Grizzlies have 10 double-figure scorers in 142-111 romp over Pelicans in NBA Cup play
articles.description: — Jerami Grant scored 22 points, including seven points on an extended possession in the first half, and the Memphis Grizzlies routed the New Orleans Pelicans 142-111 in NBA Cup group play Friday night.
